top1.title: 【2026-11-03】OpenAI、非常時に地域の電力を確保するデータセンター計画を発表
top1.lead1: OpenAIは米ジョージア州の新設データセンターで、非常時に最大1000メガワットの電力余力を確保する計画を試行する。
top1.lead2: 電力網への負担や住民の反発が課題となる中、地域への貢献を掲げる。実際の負担軽減につながるかが焦点だ。

top10.title: [2026-11-03] OpenAI announces data center plan to secure power for local communities during emergencies
top10.summary: OpenAI announced it will pilot a plan in the U.S. state of Georgia to secure up to 1,000 megawatts of spare power capacity during extreme weather or emergencies. It says the aim is to reduce strain on the local power grid.

top10.title: [2026-11-03] New York Times and others sue Brave over supplying articles to AI companies
top10.summary: The New York Times and others have sued Brave, challenging its alleged unauthorized collection of copyrighted articles, provision of those articles to AI companies, and circumvention of access restrictions on paid articles, among other practices.

top10.title: [2026-11-03] Anthropic curbs recreation of existing games using Claude Code
top10.summary: Anthropic changed the instructions for Claude Code with Opus 5.5 to curb the recreation of specific existing games. It continues to allow original works and projects using users' own materials.

top10.title: [2026-11-03] Grok Bot tightens usage limits, citing service costs
top10.summary: A succession of users reported that their weekly Grok Bot usage allowances had suddenly run out. Musk explained that the cost of providing the service was unsustainably high relative to revenue. Future limits have not yet been explained.

top10.title: [2026-11-03] 42AI unveils human behavior prediction model and $62.5 million in seed funding
top10.summary: 42AI unveiled a behavior prediction model and $62.5 million in seed funding. The model will be used by financial intermediaries, but its predictive accuracy has context-dependent limitations, and concerns remain about misuse of individual-level analysis.

top10.title: [2026-11-03] Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16 million to strengthen cooling-water monitoring
top10.summary: Omen AI acquired Aquatic Labs for $16 million in cash and stock. It aims to improve data center cooling-water management by integrating technology for monitoring substances in water and alkalinity.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
